title: Shipping Share in the Marketplace Orders Guarantee Amount Claimed
content:
**Rule.** The shipping share of the amount claimed on a Marketplace Orders Northloop Guarantee claim follows the shipping refunds already issued on the order (the late-delivery shipping and original shipping refunds together): where they reach the order's shipping charge, the amount claimed carries no shipping; where they do not and the claimed units are fewer than the units ordered, it carries the shipping charge times the claimed units over the units ordered; otherwise it carries the whole shipping charge.

The shipping part of the amount claimed is the shipping charge times that share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Share by the order's records

| Late-delivery shipping and original shipping refunds issued, together | Units the claim covers | Share of the shipping charge |
|---|---|---|
| equal to or above the shipping charge | any | none (0) |
| below the shipping charge | fewer than the units ordered | the claimed units divided by the units ordered |
| below the shipping charge | every unit ordered | the whole (1) |

Refunds of other components (item, tax) do not enter this comparison.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

Order of 3 units, shipping charge USD 8.99:

| Shipping refunds issued | Units claimed | Shipping part |
|---|---|---|
| USD 8.99 | 3 | 0.00 |
| USD 0.00 | 2 | 8.99 times 2 divided by 3, that is 5.9933, rounded half up to USD 5.99 |
| USD 0.00 | 3 | 8.99 |
| USD 4.00 | 1 | 8.99 times 1 divided by 3, that is 2.9967, rounded half up to USD 3.00 |
